file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to open

ocr.description: For an image, return recognised text instead of the picture. Automatic on models without image input; scanned PDF pages use OCR when read as text.

lossless.description: With offset + limit or ranges, show complete text lines within the existing total output budget.

offset.description: The first line to read (a negative -N starts N lines from the end); only when the whole file is too large for one read

limit.description: The most lines to return; only when the whole file is too large for one read

ranges.description: Up to 32 1-based line ranges read in one call (["1-20", "85-100", "-15"]), each keeping its continuation mark

pages.description: PDF page range ("2-6", "9", "12-24"), at most 20 pages per call

scale.description: Upscale the crop by this factor (for example 2) before reading; requires crop, within the same image output budget

crop.description: For an image: a box [x1, y1, x2, y2] in original pixels, cut before any downscale so small text stays crisp (zoom into a screenshot by re-reading it with a box); refused when it reaches outside the image or is inverted

outline.description: True returns a structural outline (signatures kept, function and method bodies elided, original line numbers kept) from the vendored tree-sitter grammar for the file type; off, the full window

line_anchors.description: True stamps each text line prefix with its content anchor ("N#hhhh"), the copyable address for anchor-qualified Edit hunks; off, the plain numbered form
